Is there any mutual exclusivity? CS3210, CS3213, ES2660, CS4248, CS4226. None are mutually exclusive with each other. Prerequisites are met. So a plan exists. Why NO_PLAN? Let me re-read carefully. 'I must take CS3210 in year 4 semester 2'. 'I must take ES2660 in year 4 semester 2'. 'I must take CS3213 in year 4 semester 2'. 'ES2660 and CS4248 must be in the same semester'.
